posts.text: To manage growing demand for Claude we're adjusting our 5 hour session limits for free/Pro/Max subs during peak hours. Your weekly limits remain unchanged. During weekdays between 5am–11am PT / 1pm–7pm GMT, you'll move through your 5-hour session limits faster than before.
posts.notes: Peak-hour session limits adjustment for Claude Code. 7.65M views — highest views in March scan, massive reply volume (2,298) indicates community friction. Market signal: Claude Max $200/mo users experiencing rate limits during peak hours. Directly relevant to the Claude Max arbitrage thesis.

posts.text: Today's Figma MCP update makes it one of the strongest integrations with Claude Code I've seen. You can now use Claude Code to design in Figma with the the full context of your design systems.
posts.notes: Figma MCP: Claude Code can now design directly in Figma with full design system context. 1.1M views, 4,929 bookmarks. Strong signal: design→code pipeline becoming fully agentic.

posts.text: Claude Code can control your computer now!
posts.notes: Claude Code gains computer use capability: mouse, keyboard, screen control. 335K views. Quote-tweet of Felix Rieseberg's announcement. Major harness expansion — from terminal coding agent to general desktop agent. Directly relevant to the 'Claude Code is not just for code' thesis.

posts.text: we're testing a new version of /init based on your feedback- it should interview you and help setup skills, hooks, etc. you can enable it with this env_var flag: CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 claude would love your feedback!
posts.notes: NEW /init redesign: interview-based setup helping users configure skills, hooks, etc. CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 flag. 588K views, 2,603 bookmarks. HIGH signal — this is the exact inverse of 'ambient config files'. Interview-driven initialization is a taste marker for the Research Librarian pattern. Directly relevant to orchestrator setup UX.

posts.text: skills are the abstraction that all agents will build on
posts.notes: Strong thesis statement: skills as the universal agent abstraction layer. References How We Use Skills article. 141K views. Quote-worthy for catalogue entries.

posts.text: We just released Claude Code channels, which allows you to control your Claude Code session through select MCPs, starting with Telegram and Discord. Use this to message Claude Code directly from your phone.
posts.notes: HIGHEST ENGAGEMENT this scan. Claude Code Channels: control sessions via Telegram/Discord MCP. 7.47M views, 18,162 bookmarks. Enables remote agent control from phone. Direct relevance: this is async orchestration via messaging platforms — highly aligned with L-Thread remote control patterns.

posts.text: Lessons from Building Claude Code: How We Use Skills
posts.notes: HIGHEST SIGNAL. Lessons from Building Claude Code: How We Use Skills. 6.59M views, 43,642 bookmarks — most-engaged post in this scan. Author 166K followers. Covers skill types, best practices, distribution methods. Definitive reference for Claude Code skills architecture.

posts.text: We just added /btw to Claude Code! Use it to have side chain conversations while Claude is working.
posts.notes: /btw feature: parallel side-chain conversation while Claude is working. 2.75M views, 6,230 bookmarks. Solves context interruption problem — ask questions without breaking the main task flow. High community excitement.

posts.text: Code Review is so so good. One of those things I can't remember how I lived without.
posts.notes: Quote-tweet endorsing Claude Code's new Code Review feature. Dispatches team of agents to hunt for bugs on PR open. 324K views. Directly relevant to orchestrator Review-Fix loop pattern (Step 5 of our loop).

posts.text: We've seen unprecedented growth in Claude and Claude Code traffic this week that was genuinely hard to forecast. We appreciate you bearing with us as we scale.
posts.notes: Traffic growth acknowledgement from Claude Code PM. 392K views. No technical signal, but strong market indicator of Claude Code adoption velocity.

posts.text: Voice mode is rolling out now in Claude Code. It's live for ~5% of users today, and will be ramping through the coming weeks. You'll see a note on the welcome screen once you have access. /voice to toggle it on!
posts.notes: Voice mode launch for Claude Code. /voice to toggle. 3.51M views, 4,234 bookmarks. Signals new interaction paradigm for coding agents: voice-first development reduces friction.
